=== examples/agent-demo
policy (Charter): agent-demo
source:  examples/agent-demo.toml

host.type     container
host.image    ghcr.io/runeeward/runeward-sandbox:latest
host.workdir  /workspace

[network]
  default: deny (allowlist below)
  allow example.com

[policy] engine: builtin
  shell       rm -rf*  -> deny
  file.write  /etc/*   -> require-approval

[budgets and limits / rationing]
  wall_clock: 30m
  max_execs: 200
  egress_requests: 500
  loop: 10 within 30s

[signed audit / chronicle]
  redact: true

=== examples/agent-session-escape-demo
policy (Charter): agent-session-escape-demo
source:  examples/agent-session-escape-demo.toml

host.type     container
host.image    ghcr.io/runeeward/runeward-agent:latest
host.workdir  /workspace
host.user     agent

[env]
  HOME             = /workspace/.agent-home          (literal)
  CODEX_HOME       = /workspace/.agent-home/.codex   (literal)
  XDG_CONFIG_HOME  = /workspace/.agent-home/.config  (literal)
  XDG_CACHE_HOME   = /tmp/.cache                     (literal)
  CODEX_API_KEY    = «redacted»                      (file)
  OPENAI_API_KEY   = «redacted»                      (file)

[network]
  default: deny (allowlist below)
  allow api.openai.com

[policy] engine: builtin
  shell  *  -> allow
  shell  *  -> allow
  shell  *  -> allow
  shell  *  -> allow
  shell  *  -> allow

[budgets and limits / rationing]
  wall_clock: 20m
  max_execs: 40
  egress_requests: 500
  loop: 8 within 60s

[cohort]
  replicas: 1

[signed audit / chronicle]
  redact: true

=== examples/build-fleet-k8s
policy (Charter): build-fleet-k8s
source:  examples/build-fleet-k8s.toml

host.type     k8s
host.image    ghcr.io/runeeward/runeward-agent:latest
host.workdir  /workspace

[env]
  CURSOR_API_KEY      = «redacted»  (file)
  CODEX_API_KEY       = «redacted»  (file)
  OPENAI_API_KEY      = «redacted»  (file)
  ANTHROPIC_API_KEY   = «redacted»  (file)
  NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY  = 1           (literal)

[network]
  default: deny (allowlist below)
  allow api.openai.com
  allow api.anthropic.com
  allow *.anthropic.com
  allow *.cursor.sh
  allow cursor.com
  allow *.cursor-cdn.com
  allow *.cursorapi.com
  allow anysphere-binaries.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com

[policy] engine: builtin
  shell       rm -rf*  -> deny
  file.write  /etc/*   -> require-approval

[budgets and limits / rationing]
  wall_clock: 45m
  max_execs: 800
  egress_requests: 4000
  loop: 12 within 60s

[cohort]
  replicas: 3

[signed audit / chronicle]
  redact: true

=== examples/cel-policy
policy (Charter): cel-policy
source:  examples/cel-policy.toml

host.type     container
host.image    debian:stable-slim
host.workdir  /workspace

[network]
  default: allow (OPEN — no egress restriction)

[policy] engine: cel
  tool == "shell" && (arg.startsWith("rm ") || arg.contains("mkfs"))  -> deny
  tool == "file.write" && arg.startsWith("/etc/")                     -> require-approval
  tool == "shell" && arg.matches("^(apt|apt-get|pip3?) .*")           -> allow

[budgets and limits / rationing]
  wall_clock: 30m
  max_execs: 200

[signed audit / chronicle]
  redact: true
